name: AMTI — Asia Maritime Transparency Initiative (CSIS)
region: South China Sea / East China Sea
desc: CSIS satellite-imagery analysis of SCS island-building, outposts, militia and maritime claims; Island Tracker.

name: SCSPI — South China Sea Strategic Situation Probing Initiative
desc: Peking University network tracking SCS military/AIS/ADS-B activity; pro-China lens, US-activity reports.

name: PLATracker
desc: Ben Lewis & Gerald Brown open-source PLA air/naval activity, Taiwan ADIZ, FONOPs, arms sales datasets.

name: ChinaPower — Taiwan ADIZ Violations (CSIS)
desc: CSIS dataset of Chinese air incursions into Taiwan's ADIZ plus broader PLA activity data points.

name: CommonWealth Magazine — PLA Activity Tracker
desc: Interactive tracker stitching open-source flight/ship data, Taiwan MND releases and imagery, daily refresh.

name: USNI News (incl. Fleet & Marine Tracker)
desc: US Naval Institute news with weekly Fleet & Marine Tracker mapping carrier/amphib group positions.

name: Naval News
desc: Naval defense news covering Chinese navy, shipbuilding, regional fleets and maritime security.

name: NOSI — Naval Open Source Intelligence
desc: Aggregated open-source naval intelligence with a dedicated Chinese Navy activity category.

name: 38 North (Stimson Center)
desc: Stimson Center informed analysis of North Korea, incl. satellite imagery of nuclear/missile sites.

name: NK News
desc: Seoul-based specialist North Korea news and analysis; some content paywalled / subscription.

name: Daily NK
desc: North Korea news sourced from in-country networks; defections, markets, internal conditions.

name: Yonhap News Agency (English)
desc: South Korea's national wire; extensive North Korea, ROK defense and peninsula security coverage.

name: IISS Myanmar Conflict Map
desc: IISS interactive dashboard mapping 60k+ violent events across Myanmar warscapes plus analysis.

name: Myanmar Witness (Centre for Information Resilience)
desc: OSINT verification of Myanmar airstrikes, atrocities and arms supply; maps, reports, public datasets.

name: ACLED — Armed Conflict Location & Event Data
desc: Disaggregated political-violence event data and crisis mapping; key feed for Myanmar and South Asia.

name: SATP — South Asia Terrorism Portal
desc: ICM database of terrorism, insurgency and conflict across South Asia; fatalities, timelines, maps.

name: Afghanistan Analysts Network (AAN)
desc: Independent field-based research on Afghanistan: war and peace, armed actors, civilian impact.

name: The Diplomat
desc: Asia-Pacific current-affairs magazine: politics, security, defense analysis across the region.

name: Lowy Institute — The Interpreter
desc: Lowy Institute commentary on Indo-Pacific politics, security, economies and regional order.

name: Janes — OSINT Insights
desc: Janes open-source defense intelligence and analysis; deep Indo-Pacific PLA and regional coverage.
